methodology: For each OOS report, build direction and guarded options from strictly prior reports only.
Rank active options by prior worst-fold PnL first, then prior aggregate PnL, Wilson lower bound, profit factor, and trade count.
Choose flat when no active mode passes prior gates, or when the best active prior worst-fold PnL is below the configured flat threshold.
Score the selected mode on the current fold only after the mode is fixed; future folds never influence current choices.
Report OOS fold-tail CVaR and recent loss-burst metrics so adaptive mode cannot pass on average PnL while hiding clustered losses.
Treat passing results as strategy hypotheses; rerun selected policies in full harness/live-replay before promotion.

notes: adaptive mode selector; rerun any selected policy in full harness before promotion
mode decisions use only prior reports and rank prior tail before aggregate PnL
flat decisions are abstentions and do not contribute OOS trades or PnL
candidate did not pass configured OOS gates
